notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

Here are the details for update 1.0.1!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192729/a5039d1fa237de0a3e67e8495ec363d69be54420.png[/img]

[h2]💡Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] New treasure chest mechanic: defeat a boss and receive a random buff by collecting the chest left by it.
[*] Trees become semi-transparent when a mob or the player passes through them.
[*] Adjustments to the minimum monster spawn starting at nine minutes.
[*] Added more phrases for Zephyra.
[*] It is now possible to zoom in the camera.
[/list]

[h2]🔥Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trees now have their own movement with the wind.
[*] Player movement is now slightly smoother.
[*] General adjustments to the menu system.
[*] The joystick analog control now has a 0.5-second interval, preventing multiple inputs in a short time.
[*] Portals now have an individual wait time for each teleported object.
[*] Improvements to the upgrade interface.
[/list]

[h2]🪲Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boss charge attacks are now properly interrupted when the game is paused.
[*] Aim control now works correctly.
[*] All allied projectiles can be teleported by portals.
[*] When leveling up multiple times, the XP bar is updated correctly.
[/list]

[h3]👉 Join our Discord to stay up to date and suggest new content![/h3]

[/url]

notes.title: Update v0.9.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here are the details for update 0.9.3!

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]

[*] New unique weapons added for each character:

[list]
[*] Steel Oath: strikes nearby enemies with a long blade.
[*] Voracious Relic: drains life energy from enemies in a cone.
[*] Wind Claws: fires a burst of arrows that pierce multiple enemies.
[*] Dragon Fang: throws a spear that deals devastating damage along its path.
[*] Solar Sword: performs a circular attack around the player.
[*] Blizzard Shard: fires icy projectiles that pierce enemies and explode in a frosty aura upon final impact.
[/list]
[*] Added new character voice lines.
[*] The final boss now has exclusive voice lines.
[*] New animations and particle effects for movements and dash actions.
[*] Added new sound effects for actions and interactions.
[*] Wind effects added to certain decorations.
[*] Added an option to disable the experience collection sound effect.
[*] Background enemies are now interactive and can be clicked on.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Starting phase 999 now begins with the player at level 1.
[*] Visual improvements to the boss in the third stage.
[*] General interface adjustments.
[*] Changes to animations and sounds when defeating enemies.
[*] Reduced the number of monsters in the first wave: 20 -> 10.
[*] Adjusted the HP of the bosses' final transformation: 25,000 -> 30,000.

[*] Rebalanced experience upgrades:

[list]
[*] Tier 1: 5% -> 7%.
[*] Tier 2: 10% -> 9%.
[*] Tier 3: 10% -> 11%.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The crypt boss now correctly flees before performing its final transformation.
[*] The "quick match" option is now hidden in the final stage selection.
[/list]

Join our Discord!
https://discord.gg/7aMjBxAAwt

Share your suggestions in the feedback channels!

Thank you very much!
Terra Bytes

Hello everyone!

[list]
[*] Area of the Regeneration Obelisk increased (65%)
[*] Healing of the Regeneration Obelisk increased (2 → 2.5)
[*] Icon scaling for cooldown increased
[*] The version will now be visible on the main screen
[*] Cooldown time of Caustic Cyclone increased (0.5 → 1.5)

[list]

[list]

[*] 3rd scenario: x0.96
[*] 4th scenario: x0.98
[*] 5th scenario: x1.0
[/list]
[*] Hell Beast health points increased (20,000 → 28,000)

[*] The Acid Pool now moves in a random direction.
[*] Speed of Acid Rain increased (23%)
[*] Players now receive knockback when trying to leave the designated area.
[/list]
